description: This file defines a PHP class that extends SugarView for rendering a map-based interface, likely for visualizing geographical areas using Google Maps API within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for displaying an HTML page with embedded JavaScript that initializes and displays polygons on a map based on provided coordinates.

classes.name: Jjwg_AreasViewArea_Detail_Map
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView that renders a map interface with polygon overlays based on provided coordinates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs an HTML page with embedded JavaScript to initialize and display a Google Map with custom polygons.
